OpenAI’s GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol announcement was inaccessible. Separate readable reporting describes a joint release aimed at demanding professional work and lower-cost everyday tasks, with company benchmark and efficiency claims.

This entry does not independently validate those claims. Third-party coverage should be used for its stated measurements and limitations, not treated as a substitute for unrestricted access to the primary evaluation methods.
highlights: Primary announcement could not be retrieved
Task cost differs from list token price
No universal model ranking is established
